Destination world/source/selector plus optional store/destination map -> same-side one-foot arrival/yaw, or null for missing/ambiguous pair. Saved sign overrides initial authored normal; no opposite-side fallback.
Validate, read and commit additive saved approach-side records. Old saves adopt empty history; duplicate/invalid/over-capacity data reject. Per-transfer lookup only; no map/asset mutation.

Resolve saved side, check destination clearance and history capacity before reservation, record successful departure after commit. Align actor/movement/perspective heading or projected fixed/isometric cursor after placement. Preserve first-person across paired 3D travel; no first-person zoom.

Rotated side persistence and real production interaction/timeline tests in Chrome/Windows. Includes blocked return, saved-state validation and post-update armed facing. Fixture maps only; no alternate transfer implementation.
